title: The Security Council, on matters other than procedure
source: Charter of the United Nations, Article 27(3)
text: Decisions of the Security Council on all other matters shall be made by an affirmative vote of nine members including the concurring votes of the permanent members.
reading: The text: each permanent member's vote is needed. In practice since 1946 an abstention of a permanent member has not been counted as a veto (ICJ, Namibia Advisory Opinion, 1971, para. 22); a rule on yes and no votes cannot show that difference.
